facts.what: Styx 向 Maddox 讲述：当年父亲（Lennox）还是小男孩时，他带儿子开自己的约翰船（john boat）出海钓鱼，结果一个雄人鱼（merman）现身。
facts.anchor: When your dad was a little boy, I took him out on my john boat to go fishing.

facts.what: Styx 因怕那雄人鱼伤害儿子，手中突然多出一把刀，刺伤了雄人鱼的手臂。
facts.anchor: I suddenly had a knife in my hand and stabbed his arm.

facts.what: Styx 回忆那雄人鱼用一双发光的绿眼睛打量 Lennox，并认定它与 Saleeni 有亲缘关系（绿眼与 Saleeni 相同）。
facts.anchor: I watched the dude observe Lennox with a pair of green eyes that glowed. I swear it.

facts.what: Maddox 意识到自己与父亲一样也属这类存在（As am I），随后双腿收拢、双臂向上，像子弹一样无声垂直扎入水中去见 Saleeni。
facts.anchor: my legs went underneath me, my arms above me, and like a bullet, I shot downward into the water.

facts.what: Maddox 用手势教 Saleeni 学话（第一个词是 Lips：左右划过下唇），Saleeni 抬手划过他的嘴唇并直视他的眼睛，跟着模仿。
facts.anchor: Saleeni reached up and swiped my lips, then looked me in the eyes.

facts.what: Saleeni 在水中发出刺耳尖叫，Styx 喊 Maddox 快去让她停下，说十英里半径内都听得见。
facts.anchor: Go! Shut her down! She’ll be heard in a ten-mile radius!

facts.what: Styx 承认自己对杀害 Maddox 父亲的凶手动了手（bleach 清洗），但安抚孙子：爷爷只有一个人，有几个跑掉了、好繁衍更多。
facts.anchor: Don’t worry. Gramps is only one man, so a few got away to breed more.

facts.what: Maddox 追问祖父对那雄人鱼的承诺有多深，Styx 悲伤地回答：直到他死（Until I die）——即这条誓言以他的性命为限。
facts.anchor: Styx looked and sounded sad when he said, “Until I die.”
